notes.html:
Comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026

Humanoid-GPT: Motion Tracking, Transformer, 2B-frame retargeted corpus pretraining, data and model capacity scaling

Not Scaled:

current - Robot Motion In-betweening -7.2M frames, 10^4 trajectories, agility and generalization trade-off

topics - insufficient scale and mismatched training design

What’s Done in Brief:

Scaled Dataset - LAFAN1, AMASS, Motion-X++, PHUMA, MotionMillion - 2B G1-retargeted

Modern Structure - causal - no future observations at test time + scalable transformer with GPT-style causal attention

Balanced Diversity - Harmonica Motion Embedding

1.Data Scaling up

a. Curation - AMASS, LAFAN1, MotionMillion, PHUMA → Filtering(Object Interactions) + Retargeting (Into 29DoF Unitree-G)

b. Harmonic Motion Embedding

Periodic AutoEncoders + HME vector + K-Means clustering

2. Scalable Generative Tracker

PPO

Some Works to Read

Dataset: motions - 9, 24, 17  multimodal - 20, 43, 7, 25  contact - 16

Motion Tracking: Early 21, 22, 6, 44  Real-world Deployment - 8, 10, 5, 14, 40, 39, 18, 29, 42, 45  Generalization: GMT, UniTracker(teacher-student), HumanPlus(Transformer)
